equip_effects: 사용 효과: 30초에 걸쳐 총 4200의 마나가 회복됩니다. 음료를 마시려면 앉아 있어야 합니다.

cuts.visual_prompt: Dutch-tilt diagonal close-up in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned pigtails, daggers sheathed) looks away with half-lidded deadpan eyes while carelessly pushing the glowing blue corked glass flask back with one hand without checking it. On the right, Skyborne Mage freezes stiffly with wide shocked star-pupil eyes, her staff stowed on her back.

Extreme big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height of centered Skyborne Mage in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Her face flushes crimson in silent trembling fury with twitching wide star-pupil eyes, comic anger veins popping, and white steam puffing from her ears as she clutches the glowing blue corked glass flask with both hands, her staff stowed on her back.
